items.title: Chubb (CB) Appoints James Wixtead And Michael O'Donnell To Lead Tempest Re
items.summary: Chubb (NYSE:CB) has announced new leadership appointments at Chubb Tempest Re, its global reinsurance business. James Wixtead will serve as Executive Chairman of Chubb Tempest Re.
